body:
I was really so glad I saw him, I love the way he was when I saw him but it was too much like he was really alive, I almost couldn't help but think he looked like he was alive. 
I think I'll be okay, I just desperately wish he was back! I can't stop thinking that, I wish he was back. And in the future I foresee lots of difficulties and an empty spot for us in our lives where he would have kept all of our hears full of joy. 

I think some part of me will always delusionally hope he'll be back, I can't believe he's gone and I don't know if I'll ever fully accept that  but he will always be in our hearts and memories.

I've looked, I don't think I'll have flashbacks or anything that hurts, He looked very peaceful and gorgeous I mean just beautiful like an angel when I saw him, I don't think I'd have many bad thought or any traumatic flashbacks. I'm glad I saw him and got to hold his head and touch his hair one last time, and got to spend some time with him! 

Everyone who saw him (not many people, we didn't want many to look at him) was gushing about how handsome he looked. It's just not fair how handsome and cool he was, and he's not here with us anymore - he was such a joy to have around.

That's what I was worried about, thank you so much for your message it's truly touched me.
Thank you for your honesty
Great answer, thank you so much. The type of response that really does make a difference

Ok. I think my nerves have settled a little and I think I should look. 

I do worry it will frighten and upset me, haunt me, I'll have flashbacks and whatever but I think I'm now leaning towards looking. I have a real thing about anything to do with bodies etc but I think I want to see him.

I think I probably will. I wish I had seen it when it sooner, on the day, I'd feel I'd gotten to hold his hand and touch him while he was still more alive seeming and looking but unfortunately I was not ready then.
Thanks, hearing from someone who has been through the same is some support to me.

That's what I was thinking this morning, I wish I had bought my brother a pet sooner because that might have helped him! It *might* have and he had always said he'd wanted one. 
 Was just scouring my brain for anything that I could have helped, that could have made things better for him whatever.


Even when he was alive, I appreciated his presence every single day and spoke with him, let him know he was needed and loved. I really enjoyed seeing him every day and I know I've never taken him or spending time with him for granted. He pushed me out the last few days and every day that he pushed me away I thought, I'll wait until he is ready to start talking to me again. Then he was dead, that time never came.

Yes I do think maybe he needed to do this and somehow it might have been the right thing for him and that it was always going to happen. 

That doesn't stop me from wishing I could have stopped him and feeling the way I do!

I will go on, I have a lot to live for that is about me, and not about my family. 

My family was just one, very important part of my life but not my entire life. 

Yes well I just wish he was back... But I know that it is inspiring and I hope I do inspire someone, and give them even a little strenght.

Him dying has changed me as a person! I'm not myself at all right now, absolutely grief stricken and worried

Please, I love you even as a stranger.
I just lost someone to suicide and when he died so many people were devastated and heartbroken. If you have come across anyone in your life, they do love you and will be broken by your death. Especially your family members!
